description: This Kotlin source file defines an Android activity (MainActivity) that implements a voice-to-text feature using Android's SpeechRecognizer API. The activity manages microphone permissions, updates the UI based on recognition states, and simulates a search operation triggered automatically after speech recognition results.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages voice recognition, updates UI components, handles permissions, and simulates search operations based on recognized speech.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up speech recognizer and its listener, and defines button click behavior to start or stop listening.

methods.name: triggerAutoSearch
methods.description: Simulates a search based on recognized speech, updating UI to show loading and then displaying a placeholder result.

methods.name: setSearchingUiState
methods.description: Updates UI components to reflect whether a search is in progress.

methods.name: startListeningWithPermissionCheck
methods.description: Checks for microphone permission and initiates listening if granted, otherwise requests permission.

methods.name: hasRecordAudioPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to record audio.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles user response to permission requests.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as callbacks and speech recognizer upon activity destruction.
